risks.title: Material weaknesses in financial reporting controls
risks.score_rationale: The risk is at the top of the 'Risks Related to Previous Delinquent SEC Reporting Obligations' section and describes unremediated material weaknesses in internal controls. The language is strong: 'not effective', 'prevent fraud and errors', 'investors may lose confidence'. Compared to the prior year, the situation persists as of June 30, 2025. The Regulation category has high weight in case of material non-compliance.

risks.title: Delays in SEC reporting obligations
risks.score_rationale: The delay in filing 10-K and 10-Q reports is explicitly mentioned as having caused downward pressure on stock price, loss of business opportunities and increased costs. The language is alarming: 'delinquent', 'downward pressure on stock price', 'reputational harm'. It is a recurring risk since the prior year. The Regulation category is critical here.

risks.title: Dependence on concentrated key customers
risks.score_rationale: The risk is listed early in the operational section and mentions a 'substantial' risk of revenue loss if a major customer reduces orders. The language is clear: 'sales are concentrated', 'revenue may decrease substantially'. It is stable compared to prior year. The Competition category implies vulnerability in commercial negotiation.

risks.title: Volatility of essential components
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned as affecting cost, delivery and warranty management. The language is concerning: 'adversely affected by volatility'. It is stable compared to prior year. The Industrial category is important in a tight supply chain context.

risks.title: Dependence on Ablecom and Compuware
risks.score_rationale: The text highlights a risk of reliance on a limited number of providers for manufacturing and warehousing. The language is explicit: 'reliance on a limited source'. It is a stable structural risk. The Industrial category reflects a major operational vulnerability.

risks.title: Risk related to AI and technological innovation
risks.score_rationale: The text links the company's recent success to the AI industry, while highlighting its 'risks and uncertainties'. The language is cautious: 'driven a portion of our recent success', 'presents risks'. It is an emerging, but central, risk. The Technology category is highly strategic.

risks.title: Ongoing legal disputes and investigations
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned as potentially leading to substantial costs and changes in business practices. The language is strong: 'substantial costs', 'material adverse effect'. It is stable compared to prior year. The Litigation category has a direct impact on results and reputation.

ai_positioning.summary: The company SMCI does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report.
